description.en: StudyHub: a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your own material into questions and spaced review · 把自己的资料变成题目与间隔复习的 DSH 学习插件
DeepSeek Harness 插件：增加「纯文本对话模式」agent 预设——整份替换系统提示词进行纯角色对话，只保留联网搜索与表情包。随包人设文本整理自开源项目 Cyrene-Agent（MIT）。
MCP server bridge for DeepSeek Harness: stdio / streamable-http / legacy-SSE transports, web settings UI (form + JSON), tools as mcp__<server>__<tool>. Burp Suite ready out of the box.
An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Harness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes.
Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key，并跟踪网关兼容性。

Third-party dsh web plugin: a rich Markdown notebook for the composer region — tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service
Ollama-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web): one web_search backend calling POST https://ollama.com/api/web_search.

MemOS Cloud lifecycle memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness
AI Services: shared model routing, bounded auxiliary calls, and usage receipts for other plugins.
Telegram channel for DeepSeek Harness — real Telegram markdown, and answer the agent's questions and approvals straight from chat
MiOpIIk：DeepSeek Harness 单职责插件集 + 四层 agent 工作流 preset（npm: dsh-miopiik）
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上一套四层 agent 工作流，管好子代理执行、检查点和断点恢复。

description.en: DSH 聊天机器人管理入口：渠道注册表、共享内核与设置页入口（飞书/微信等渠道各自独立成插件）
Sign in to vendor coding plans that have no API key at all (Claude Pro/Max/Team, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, GitHub Copilot, SuperGrok) from the dsh settings UI
description.zh: 没有 API Key 也能登录 Claude、ChatGPT、Copilot 等 AI 编程套餐，直接在 dsh 设置里完成授权。

description.en: TaskPilot — dock pills above the composer for background jobs and subagents, with stop/interrupt verbs, live duration and token readouts, and a job detail right-sidebar tab. A zero-intrusion community bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

Management center: link skill directories into the user skills root (enable/disable/unlink/delete) and manage MCP servers — add/edit/delete, import from other agents (Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI), auto-load each project's own MCP servers via the l
Experience Learning: learn conditional methods from outcome evidence, with optional export as skills.
以 dsh-bridge 为根基的 DSH 远程访问网关：局域网 / Cloudflare 隧道 / Tailscale 隧道 / 自建隧道 / 公网直连网关 / IM Bot，全部在 Web 面板中配置。

DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控（兼容加固版）：Flash 模型预判写/命令是否不可回补，安全自动批准、危险转人工（fail-safe），最小人工介入，听人工审查 UI。基于 dsh-approval-gate 0.5.2，修复 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 API 兼容与插件路由鉴权；0.2.2 补齐 Windows/PowerShell 拒绝词表与路径处理、原子写与配置损坏备份、diff 复杂度、事件/审计日志轮转、CSRF 防线；0.2.3 修复并发丢失更新（审批串行化）、下游异常终态
Data inventory plugin: directory scanning, value assessment, asset list generation Also known as @deepseek-ai/dsh-data-inventory.
DSH settings UI for shared plugin logging levels and file format

Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.
description.zh: Anima 式向量记忆：每轮把语义检索到的历史总结注入 system prompt，提供 anima_query 检索工具，向量库按周目隔离；SiliconFlow 嵌入（数组形状请求），嵌入超时/网络错分级如实写进注入格，绝不静默失败。

description.en: Maintained fork of dsh-prompt-enhance, brought up to DSH 0.1.7 — the plugin would not even load on current hosts (InputState.imageIds became attachmentIds, so the composer button crashed the input box; settings.get() was removed; /enhance read a session id the agent no longer exposes). Rewrites default to reasoningEffort off, which measured 252 output tokens for a draft where the model default spent 2897, and a Settings page for all 17 fields is bundled. Verified on a real 0.1.7-rc.2 host: activation, a live HTTP enhancement request, /enhance in the GUI, and the Settings page reading and persisting configuration. 204 tests.
description.zh: dsh-prompt-enhance 的维护分支，已适配 DSH 0.1.7——此前的版本在当前宿主上甚至无法加载（InputState.imageIds 已更名为 attachmentIds，输入框按钮会让整个输入区崩溃；settings.get() 已被移除；/enhance 读取了 agent 不再暴露的会话 id）。改写默认使用 reasoningEffort off：实测同一段草稿为 252 输出 token，而模型自身默认档要 2897；并内置覆盖全部 17 个字段的设置页。已在真实的 0.1.7-rc.2 宿主上验证：插件激活、真实 HTTP 增强请求、GUI 中 /enhance 执行，以及设置页读取并持久化配置。204 项测试。

description.en: DSH plugin: drive a real Chrome from your dsh agent via the browser-use Browser Harness (local, no API key).
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接写 Python 操控真实 Chrome，自动导航、点击、填表、截图，本地运行无需 API Key。
